# Language Origin

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageOrigin`](gmeow-LanguageOrigin.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageOrigin>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

How a language came to be (natural, constructed, AI-generated, formal, pidgin, creole, reconstructed, …). A value, not a [`Language`](gmeow-Language.md) subclass: origins are open-ended and share [`Language`](gmeow-Language.md)'s structure.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LanguageOrigin`](gmeow-LanguageOrigin.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
